features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You always have a number of cleric spells prepared as shown in the Prepared Spells column, and you know cantrips from the Cleric spell list. Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Divine Order
features.description: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice: Protector (proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor) or Thaumaturge (an extra cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier to Intelligence (Arcana) and Intelligence (Religion) checks).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Divine Spark and Turn Undead. You gain more uses of Channel Divinity as you reach higher levels (three at 6th level, four at 18th), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Cleric Subclass
features.description: You gain a Cleric subclass (a Divine Domain) of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Cleric levels.

features.name: Smite Undead
features.description: When you use Turn Undead, you can expend a spell slot to deal Radiant damage to each affected Undead equal to 1d8 plus the slot's level.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.description: Divine power infuses you in battle. You gain one of the following options of your choice: Divine Strike (once per turn, deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage on a weapon hit) or Potent Spellcasting (add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips).

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: As a Magic action, you can cast any cleric spell of level 5 or lower without expending a spell slot or material components. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.description: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful: Divine Strike's extra damage increases to 2d8, or Potent Spellcasting lets allies within 30 feet benefit when you cast a damaging cantrip.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.description: When you use Divine Intervention, you can choose the effect of the Wish spell. If you do, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.
